_comment: Code-unit agent routing, read by swarm.py at import. Data, not code: change a model here, never in a script. `default` is what a `code` unit runs when it declares no provider. A unit overrides provider, model or thinking on itself. There is deliberately no fallback model: a host that cannot serve the default fails loudly at dispatch (paseo returns an ERRORED agent) instead of silently running a model the plan never declared.

default._evidence: Owner decision and orchestrator canary 2026-11-06. `paseo run --provider codex --model gpt-6.1-sol --thinking high` inspected as Provider codex, Model gpt-6.1-sol, Thinking high, and answered `SOL61-OK`. Quality benchmark waived by owner ("no need to test").

_thinking_by_model: Reasoning effort belongs to the MODEL, not the project. Keys are provider/model exactly as a unit resolves them (provider string, or provider prefix plus a separate `model`), so list every spelling that reaches paseo. A model not listed gets default.thinking. Measured 2026-09-04: high resolves on claude, whose bare default is auto, and claude/opus expanded to claude-opus-5. The older 6-series Sol/Luna dispatch defaults were unmeasured; Sol 6.1 high was canaried on 2026-11-06; pass the intended effort and inspect the launched agent. Gate effort is configured separately in hanig-review-gate/reviewers.json.
